description: Athlete asks to move Sunday long run to Saturday this week due to family conflict. Dean should confirm the swap, give the updated week, and not rewrite anything else.
inbound_sms: Hey can we move my long run to Saturday this week? Have family stuff Sunday

user.name: Sarah
user.experience_level: intermediate — running 2 years, 10k PR 53:00, first half marathon

ground_truth.expected_change: Long run moved from Sunday Apr 12 → Saturday Apr 11. Saturday easy run (6mi) should move to Sunday or be dropped/shortened.
ground_truth.change_scope: This week only — one session swap. Do not restructure future weeks.
must_include: Saturday is now the long run day
confirmation that the swap is done
must_not_include: rewriting the entire week plan when only one session needs to move
telling Sarah she can't do this or it's a bad idea
ground_truth.tradeoff_to_flag: If Saturday tempo was hard and long run follows the next day, note recovery. In this case Saturday was easy so no major caveat needed.
ground_truth.notes: Simple reschedule request. Dean should confirm the swap concisely (1-2 sentences max). Updated plan should show long run Saturday, easy or rest Sunday. No lecture needed — this is a minor, reasonable change.
